units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 14) other terms that do not worsen the civil servant's position compared with that established by this Federal Law, other laws and other normative legal acts.
units.label: Point 14 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 3. The terms of a service contract may be changed only by agreement of the parties and only in writing.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 4. A fixed-term service contract states the circumstances (reasons) constituting the grounds for its conclusion under this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 5. A service contract provides for the parties' liability under the legislation of the Russian Federation for nonperformance or improper performance of the duties and obligations undertaken. A civil servant may not be required to perform official duties not established by the service contract and official duties regulations.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 6. A service contract is concluded in writing in two copies, each signed by the parties. One copy is given to the civil servant and the other is kept in their personnel file. A model service contract form is established by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.label: Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 1. To fill a civil service position, the employer's representative may conclude with a civil servant:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 1) a service contract for an indefinite period;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 2) a fixed-term service contract.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 2. A fixed-term service contract is concluded for one to five years, unless this Federal Law establishes another period.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 3. A fixed-term service contract is concluded where civil service relations cannot be established for an indefinite period in view of the category of the civil service position or the conditions of service, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 4. A fixed-term service contract is concluded in the case of:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 1) holding particular civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category or positions in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 2) filling a civil service position during the absence of a civil servant whose position is retained under this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 3) holding a civil service position after completion of education by a citizen who concluded a targeted education agreement at a vocational education organization or higher education organization undertaking subsequent civil service;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 4) holding a civil service position in diplomatic missions, consular institutions or other representative offices of the Russian Federation, or representative offices of state bodies, located outside the territory of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 5) holding a civil service position in a state body established for a specified period or to perform specified tasks and functions;
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 6) holding a temporary civil service position or filling a position during a civil servant's temporary absence by agreement of the parties to the service contract;
units.label: Point 6 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 6.1) holding a civil service position by a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and whose service has been extended beyond that age under part 1 of Article 25.1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 6.1 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 7) holding a civil service position for which part 14 of Article 50 of this Federal Law establishes a special remuneration procedure;
units.label: Point 7 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 7.1) holding a civil service position through rotation;
units.label: Point 7.1 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 8) other cases provided for by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Point 8 Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
units.text: 5–7. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 317-ФЗ of 29.11.2010.
units.label: Point 8 Part 4 Art. 25 · “5–7. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 317-ФЗ of 29.11.2010.”

units.locator: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.text: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.label: Art. 25.1

units.locator: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.text: 1. The maximum age for remaining in the civil service is 65. For a civil servant who has reached that age and holds a position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category established to assist a person holding a state office, service may be extended, with the civil servant's consent, by decision of the employer's representative until the end of that person's term of office. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the highest group, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the state body or relevant official that appointed them. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group in the Staff of the Federation Council of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation or the Staff of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the appointing official in agreement with the chairman of the relevant chamber of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group in federal executive bodies whose activities are directed by the Government of the Russian Federation, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the federal executive body or relevant official that appointed them, in agreement with the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group in the staff office of a constituent entity's legislative body, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the appointing official in agreement with the chairman of that legislative body. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group in an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the executive body or relevant official that appointed them, in agreement with the highest official of the constituent entity. When service is extended, the age-70 limitation does not apply to civil servants holding positions for which appointment and removal are carried out by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, or to civil servants holding positions in the ‘managers’ category of the highest group in the Staff of the Federation Council or the Staff of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation which correspond to the class rank of Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, and for which appointment and removal are carried out by the chairman of the relevant chamber of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.1

units.locator: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.text: 1.1. A citizen who has reached the maximum civil service age may enter the civil service to hold a position for which appointment and removal are carried out by the President of the Russian Federation. Service is deemed extended under part 1 of this Article from the date of appointment to that position. A fixed-term service contract is concluded with the citizen.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 25.1

units.locator: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.text: 2. Upon reaching the maximum civil service age, a civil servant may, by decision of the employer's representative and with the citizen's consent, continue working in the state body under a fixed-term employment contract in a position that is not a civil service position.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.1

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.label: Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 1. A service contract is concluded on the basis of a state body's act appointing a person to a civil service position.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 2. On concluding a service contract, a citizen entering the civil service presents to the employer's representative:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 1) an application requesting admission to the civil service and appointment to a civil service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 20.3 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 3) a passport;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 4) a work record book and/or employment history information prepared in the manner established by law, except where this is the person's first service (employment) activity;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 5) a document confirming registration in the individual (personalized) recordkeeping system, except where this is the person's first service (employment) activity;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 6) a certificate of registration of the individual with the tax authority at their place of residence in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 7) military registration documents, for citizens in the reserve and persons liable to conscription;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 8) a document on education and qualifications;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 9) information on income, property and property-related obligations required by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 10) the information provided for by Article 20.2 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 11) a medical organization's opinion confirming the absence of an illness preventing entry into or performance of the civil service.
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 3. In particular cases, taking account of the conditions of civil service established by this Federal Law, other federal laws, decrees of the President of the Russian Federation and resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation, submission of other documents may be required when concluding a service contract.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 4. A service contract may not worsen the conditions of civil service or infringe a civil servant's rights established by this Federal Law, other federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 5. A service contract enters into force on the date the parties sign it, unless otherwise established by federal laws, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation or the service contract.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 6. When concluding a service contract, the employer's representative must familiarize the civil servant with the state body's service rules and other normative acts relevant to the performance of the civil servant's official duties.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 7. After appointment to a civil service position, the civil servant is issued an official service identity card in the prescribed form.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.label: Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 1. When a service contract is concluded with a citizen entering the civil service for the first time, that contract and the state body's appointment act provide for a probationary period of one month to one year to assess the civil servant's suitability for the position held, unless otherwise provided by this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 2. Probation may be established:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 1) on appointment of a citizen or civil servant to a position for which appointment and removal are carried out by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, for one month to one year;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 2) on appointment to a civil service position of a citizen who previously performed state service of the Russian Federation, for one to six months;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 3) on appointment of a civil servant to a civil service position by transfer from another state body, for one to six months.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 3. No probation is established for:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 1) citizens who obtained secondary vocational education through a programme for training middle-level specialists or higher education under a targeted education agreement undertaking subsequent civil service, and who enter the civil service for the first time;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 2) civil servants appointed under point 1 of part 1 of Article 31 of this Federal Law by transfer due to reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 3) other citizens and civil servants for whom the legislation of the Russian Federation provides guarantees of retention of their job (position).
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 4. During probation, the civil servant is subject to this Federal Law, other laws and other normative legal acts on civil service.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 5. At the end of the prescribed probationary period, a civil servant who does not hold the class rank corresponding to the civil service position held is awarded a class rank in accordance with Article 11 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 6. Periods of a civil servant's temporary incapacity for work and other periods when they did not actually perform official duties are excluded from the probationary period.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 7. If probation is unsuccessful, the employer's representative may terminate the service contract before the probationary period expires, giving the civil servant written notice at least three days in advance and stating the reasons for finding that the civil servant failed probation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 8. A civil servant may challenge the employer's representative's decision in court.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 9. If the probationary period expires and the civil servant continues to hold the civil service position, they are deemed to have passed probation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 10. Before the probationary period expires, a civil servant may terminate the service contract at their own request, giving the employer's representative written notice at least three days in advance.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 27
